name: 74447 · Okmulgee, OK
findings: ZIP 74447 (Okmulgee) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74447 (Okmulgee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
